result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there is a notable state inconsistency in the bottom navigation, plus a few edge/cropping issues in horizontal carousels that hurt polish.

issues.description: The bottom navigation shows 'Profile' as the active (highlighted green) tab, but the screen displayed is clearly the Home/discovery feed. The 'Home' tab should be active.
issues.suggestion: Fix the active-tab state logic so the highlighted nav item matches the currently displayed screen (Home should be highlighted here).

issues.description: The last category chip in the filter row (after 'Healthy') is cut off at the right edge with no visible label, appearing as an empty sliver of a pill.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing/peek width so partially visible chips show at least part of their label, or add a gradient fade to clearly indicate horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: The third restaurant card title 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated abruptly at the screen edge without an ellipsis, making the name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Apply text ellipsis within the card bounds or ensure card text wraps inside the visible card area rather than being clipped by the viewport.

issues.description: The pizza card in 'Popular right now' is cut off at the bottom by the navigation bar, hiding its title, rating, and delivery info.
issues.suggestion: If this is not just mid-scroll state, add bottom padding to the scroll container so the last card's metadata is fully visible above the tab bar.
